committee: * Presentation for Legislative Resolution No. 148-38 (COR) -Office of Legislative Secretary Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
title: Hafa Adai, Join me in presenting Legislative Resolution No. 148-38 (COR). Legislative Resolution 148-38 will be presented recognizing the National Association of Women in Construction (NAWIC) Guam Chapter 381 during the observance of Women in Construction Week from March 1st through March 7th, 2026. The presentation commemorates the chapter’s fourteenth (14th) anniversary while acknowledging its continued dedication to supporting professional growth and advancement for women within Guam’s construction industry.
